text:
Alex G: Quick sync — ACME asked for a clear onramp doc + upgrade guarantees for private deploy (VPC + on-prem). They want minimal ops burden for their NetOps team and a defined rollback window.
Mira L: thanks — do they require static egress IP preservation?
Alex G: yes, they care about egress IPs and tenant IP preservation across upgrades. Also asked about KMS integration and audit logs.
Samir: we should surface two lanes: 1) lightweight operator + relay (best for AWS customers behind NAT) 2) full VPC tenant mode (for dedicated IPs). Different upgrade guarantees for each.
Joel: +1. For operator lane we can promise N-1 patch upgrades with 24h canary, for VPC tenant lane we need a staged rolling upgrade with IP preservation tests.
Mira L: can we write the onramp doc to show concrete upgrade SLAs? e.g. "canary 1% for 2h, ramp 10% for 6h, full at 24h" and rollback criteria on error rate + latency spikes?
Samir: that works. add: "if egress IP moves during upgrade, immediate rollback and postmortem" (ACME flagged this as deal breaker).
Alex G: ACME also asks for an offline installer variant. It's ok to require a maintenance window for airgap upgrades — they'd accept 2–4 hour windows.
Joel: note: airgap installs will need operator-shim v0.9+ and explicit DB migration checks. We'll add a preflight step before upgrade that fails fast.
Mira L: Ops ask: how do we support their KMS? we currently support AWS KMS + GCP KMS. ACME uses HashiCorp Vault via Transit — do we have a plan?
Samir: short term: document Vault as customer-managed KMS via env secrets and key rotation script. Mid-term: add native Vault plugin (Q3).
Alex G: include troubleshooting playbook: quick commands and where to check token-level billing when running in private.
Joel: suggest a short sample helm/values snippet for operator lane to show network-related fields.
Alex G: good idea. Mira, can you add snippet?
Mira L: sure — draft below:
```
# values.yaml (operator lane)
network:
  mode: operator-relay
  egress:
    preserve_ips: false
    relay_endpoint: "relay.acme.example:443"
  canary: 0.01
upgradePolicy:
  stagedRollout: true
  canaryDuration: 2h
  rampDuration: 6h
  maxUnavailable: 1
```
Samir: include an alternate for tenant-vpc mode with egress.preserve_ips: true and a note about IPAM handoff.
Mira L: added note: "tenant-vpc requires NetOps to provide a CIDR allocation + peering or BGP — see netops-handbook link" (we'll include link in final doc).
Alex G: what's our recommended rollback window? ACME wants a max 6h risk window for ip drift. Can we commit?
Joel: we can commit to immediate rollback on ip drift and a max 6h escalated resolution SLA with on-call support for enterprise customers. For self-serve we provide automation to revert but not guaranteed human SLA.
Mira L: action items: 1) produce one-pager on lanes + upgrade SLAs (Mira) 2) sample values + preflight checklist (Mira) 3) KMS Vault short-term doc (Samir) 4) legal note on IP handoff (Alex) 5) add rollout templates to Console checklist (Joel).
Samir: ops-bot FYI scheduling: ops-bot, please open a canary-run ticket and link to playbook.
ops-bot: Created ticket #CAN-1289 and scheduled a 1% canary run for next Wed 09:00 UTC.
Alex G: thanks — I'll share this with ACME and loop legal. If we can get the one-pager by EOD tomorrow, we should be good for the call on Friday. :thumbsup:
